notes.title: Update v1.1.11
notes.notes:
Yamafuda! has just celebrated its first anniversary! Thank you!
We have made additions, adjustments, and fixes.

Additions

 Now you can listen to music from your Hikes! When two character hike all the mountains, it will appear on the mountain selection screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/2ae2ff08b3e9a9cbb881cad5784c544e13f3009e.gif

Adjustments

 Gear "Radio" Every time use 3 cards, [Excite] +1
 Gear "Stuff Bag" Whenever use up deck 1 time, [Quick] +1
 Gear "Burning" Every time life decreases, [Eager] +4
 Gear "Glove" If you have extra protection, Gain [Eager]
 Gear "Eisen" Every time get [Cold], [Excite] +3
 Gear "Whistle" First turn, [Step] +8

Fixed

 Corrected translation errors
 Fixed an issue that occurs when buttons are operated while switching screens

Have a good hike!

notes.title: 【Yamafuda! 2nd station Android Version】 Released!
notes.notes:
Android version released!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/9a4bf9f316bd6debb078e3e202bfdd0a766de6f3.jpg
Google Play 【Yamafuda! 2nd station】


The content is the same as the PC version.
To make it run comfortably The graphics have been slightly reduced to make the game run more comfortably. The price is moderate.
First, download the sound data. Please start the application in an environment with WiFi for the first time.
(The sound quality is the same as the PC version!)


Enjoy hiking anytime, anywhere!

notes.title: Update v1.1.10
notes.notes:
Hello! It's a good season for hiking.

We have fixed the problems you informed us about.
Thanks for the info!

Fixed

 When you summit a mountain, if you open a list of mountain tags, etc., you will not be able to progress.
 Gear "Curiosity" When the maximum energy is increased, to recover the same value.

Have a good hike!

notes.title: Update v1.1.9
notes.notes:
Thanks to you, our cumulative reviews are now "very favorable!" Thank you!
We have made additions, adjustments, and fixes.

Additions

 Added a hiking record display (list of cards and gear) to the result screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/c2d3aeae2dc6d8cda243cc88bf757c00692524de.gif
 Manipulate the playback position of the scene while displaying the hiking record.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/1ef38dc1a1e38dd6dc738ab40dfb6b76fae2351a.gif

Adjustments

 Slightly lowered the dread of a strong mountain attack
 Scree　Regardless of the condition, you will find two pieces of stone.
 Gear "Snail"　When the [Hike] is less than 9, [Care] +2
 Koharu's "Brace" : 2/8 to 2/9
 Koharu's "Runway" : 1/7 to 1/8
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "ZigZag" : 5/10 to 5/11[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "Skip" : Exite 3 to 4[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "Heavily" : 7/9 to 7/10[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "Jump" : Twinkle 3 to 4[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "TrailRun" : 23/6 to 26/6[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Hiyori's "Stride" : Changed "Colorful" effects to work on [Care] as well[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Pedometer" : Every 3 times you hike [Battery] +1[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Cryostat" : First turn, [Exite] +5, [Cold] +2[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Optimization" : Every time make an [Autogear], [Exite] +2[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Miniature" : Every time use [Back], [Exite] +2[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Auxiliary power" : First turn, [Battery] +2[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Electric goat" : When the [Battery] is full, [Hike] +11[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Gear "Lull heart" : If you use [Nothing], [Care] +14[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Autogear "Walker" : Back: [step] +6 to +7[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Autogear "Roader" : Back: [careful] +3 to +5[/spoiler]

Fixed

 Gear "Diverfairy" : an unconditional increase in [Care] by 2
 Minor graphic problems

Have a good hike!

notes.title: Update v1.1.8
notes.notes:
Thank you for all the bug reports! Adjustments and fixes have been made.

Adjustments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103260/8e69295be7fdf6df4e8e6516d3f9451b3a52508e.gif

 "Check" The effect of "Flawless" is now available from the turn you use it
 "Flawless" Values above 1 are now also prevented all together. It also prevents "rockfall"
 "Helmet" Prevent "rockfall" by 1 -> Now prevents all of them, regardless of the number

Fixed

 "Rest" Click left and right at the same time to create two gears

Have a good hike!

notes.title: V1.1.6: Update

It's fall foliage season! I have made some additions, adjustments and corrections.

Additions

 One gear

Adjustments

 Additional effect to "Yahho"
 If there's no rest ahead, don't bring out the relevant gear
 If there's no rain ahead, don't bring out rainwear
 Reinforce the "Treasure box" and "Locket heart"

Fixed

 Difficult-to-understand text in help for card and gear
 When opening the options screen, the tutorial can proceed.
 BGM sometimes disappears.

Have a good hike!
